name: @hasna/computers
description: Durable lifetime computers for AI employees
author: Hasna

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run scripts/build.ts && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test:postgres-migrations: command -v psql >/dev/null && test "$(psql -X -qAt -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'SHOW server_version_num;' 2>/dev/null)" = 160013 && test "$(psql -X -qAt -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user;' 2>/dev/null)" = t || { echo 'PostgreSQL 16.13 superuser with local postgres database access is required for migration verification' >&2; exit 1; }; bash scripts/test-postgres-migrations.sh
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run lint && bun run check:schemas && bun run check:surfaces && bun run build
scripts.verify:release: bun run check && bun run test:postgres-migrations && bun run verify:pack && bun run ../../tooling/ci/check-audit-packed.mjs && bun pm untrusted
scripts.canary:local-mac: bun run src/bin/computers.ts local config canary
